reply_text:
I saved Dana's note that Dock 38 is her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from now on, and replied in her DM to confirm.

- **What I saved:** a memory under her name in the brain, with the DM and time recorded as the source. Nothing in the brain said which dock she used before, so nothing was replaced. That search was keyword-only, so an older note worded differently could have been missed.
- **Kept private:** my first save came back visible to everyone. She told me this in a DM, so I saved it again as private to her and withdrew the first copy.
- **No other action:** she said none was needed, so I didn't post it anywhere or tell anyone else.
